class.name: ResourceImporterGIF
class.brief_description: Imports a [code].gif[/code] file as a [GIFAnimation], [SpriteFrames], or first-frame texture.
class.description: Default import creates a [GIFAnimation]. Choose [b]Sprite Frames[/b] to drop the file onto [AnimatedSprite2D], or [b]First Frame Texture[/b] for a still [ImageTexture]. Registering the GIF image loader also lets the existing texture importer treat [code].gif[/code] as a first-frame still.
